display_information.name: Tin
display_information.description: Posts your Tin workflow summaries and reads the channels it is in. Never reads DMs.
display_information.long_description: Tin runs marketing for your business as scheduled workflows. Connect this app from Integrations in your Tin project, then choose, for each saved workflow that writes a summary, the Slack channels where it is posted when a run finishes. Tin can list channels, post, and read the messages and threads of channels its app is a member of, so what you discuss there informs its work. It never reads direct messages. It posts to any public channel, and to a private channel once someone adds the app to it.
